resolving.heading: Where is the game installed?
resolving.text: JKNet needs the folder that holds base\assets0.pk3 to assets3.pk3.
resolving.failed: Restart the launcher once the problem is fixed.

gameFiles.heading: Where are the games installed?
gameFiles.text: JKNet needs the folder that holds base\assets0.pk3. It reads those archives and writes nothing into the folder. One game is enough to carry on; add the other whenever you like.
gameFiles.noCopy: No copy of {{game}} turned up in Steam or GOG. Point JKNet at the folder yourself, or skip this game.
gameFiles.chooseAnotherText: Pick the GameData folder of any copy. JKNet checks it before you continue.
gameFiles.unreadable: The folder holds no readable archives.
gameFiles.license: JKNet does not ship game files. You need a licensed copy of Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy or Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast from Steam, GOG or a disc.

client.heading: Create your first client
client.text: A client is an engine build with its own files and settings. JKNet downloads the engine for you, and you can add more clients later.
client.manualInstall: This build has to be installed by hand.
client.nameHint: Its files go into <0>clients\{{folder}}</0> inside the JKNet data folder. Renaming the client later keeps that folder.
client.askingGithub: Asking GitHub for the newest build…
client.cacheNote: The archive lands in the JKNet cache, so a second client on the same engine installs without another download.
client.failedTitle: The client is created. Its engine is not installed yet.
client.failedText: Folder <0>clients\{{folder}}</0>. Retry the download, or skip it and install the engine later from the Clients screen.

account.offText: Everything you have set up so far works without an account. Your game files, your settings and your saves stay on this machine.
account.signedInText: Your friends list and your invites follow this account from now on.
account.heading: Sign in, or play as a guest
account.text: An account is optional. Everything you have set up so far works without one, and you can sign in later from Settings.
account.providerFailed: {{message}} You can play as a guest and sign in later.
account.benefitFriends: A friends list, with an invite that works without port forwarding.
account.benefitSync: Your library and your favourite servers on every machine you play from.
account.benefitName: A name other players recognise, instead of one typed into each server.
account.privacy: JKNet stores your account name and who your friends are. Your game files, your settings and your saves stay on this machine.
